map.1.5 kW 空调日运行 6 h：日耗电 9 kWh、月 270 kWh、电费约: A 1.5 kW air conditioner running 6 h/day: daily consumption 9 kWh, monthly 270 kWh, electricity cost about 157 CNY (0.58 CNY/kWh). Switching to a more efficient unit or raising the temperature by 1℃ saves 10%, about 16 CNY/month. Tip: an inverter unit is more efficient at part load.
map.功率×时间就是电费吗？: Is power × time the electricity cost?
map.得电量 kWh，再乘电价才是电费；注意阶梯电价下增量电价更高。: It gives the energy in kWh; multiply by the electricity price to get the cost. Note that under tiered tariffs the incremental price is higher.
map.待机也算功耗吗？: Does standby count as power consumption?
map.算。待机虽小但全年累积可观，集中插座断电可省。: Yes. Standby is small but accumulates considerably over the year; a centralized switch can save it.
map.用电计算是一款能源电力领域的在线工具。能源电力工具，帮助计算能耗与电力参数。: Electricity Usage Calculation is an online tool in the energy and power domain. An energy and power tool that helps compute energy consumption and power parameters.
map.家庭用电估算（本页代码口径，电器列表逐项累加）：每电器日耗电=功率 W×日均时长: Household electricity estimate (as implemented on this page, summing the appliance list item by item): daily consumption per appliance = power W × daily hours h ÷ 1000 (kWh); period consumption = daily consumption × days; electricity cost = consumption × price (CNY); the total consumption and total cost are aggregated, the daily average = ÷ days, and each appliance's share = its consumption ÷ total consumption × 100 (%), shown as a distribution bar chart. Validation: an empty appliance list prompts you to add appliances first; an empty day count falls back to 1. Criteria: no fixed grading; the price is entered in CNY/kWh, and the appliance shares always sum to 100%.
